finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings are still there. They are true noise. Five are Node deprecations from bumped deps. Three point at files not in this repo.

Next: nothing, unless you want the deprecations chased upstream.
